notApplicable.zoom-200-static-baseline: The loading indicator keeps its natural continuous animation at real browser zoom. Native video and timed full-viewport PNG samples are reviewed; moving states do not establish static pixel baselines.
notApplicable.touch: The activity indicator has no pointer action or hit target; inert blocking is verified in the overlay state, and wrapped controls own touch geometry.
notApplicable.density: Activity indicators use their explicit size and do not use collection density.
notApplicable.hover-focus-pressed: The indicator itself is not interactive; wrapped content is inert while loading.
notApplicable.disabled-selected-error: Loading is an activity state. Disabled and validation feedback belong to the owning content.
